text: Inside of cart/editor there is the file menu which has a new mesh nested menu, that shows Cube Cylinder Cone Pyramid, etc, and then also has an area for Player / NPC model, i want you to expand this and give me a starting point from the basic floor piece, wall piece, roof piece, stair piece, ramp piece, and whatever other build pieces there are. so i can use the base shape to build from without needing to construct the base shape from scratch every time to then build from
resolution: Expanded File → New Mesh with a nested Build Pieces starter set covering every active semantic build kind: wall, floor, roof, ramp, stairs, elevator, pillar, corner, arch, fence, railing, trim, and sign. Each choice opens a uniquely identified, catalog-sized editable model derived from the existing build-piece shape decomposition, so authors start from the real game module instead of rebuilding it from generic primitives. Added durable starter package identity, preserved the Player / NPC entry, fixed the arch starter to be an open frame, added focused menu/identity/geometry tests, shipped the ReleaseFast editor, and visually smoke-tested the stair starter headlessly.
